acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Ira talks with Jessica Pressler about a phenomenon she noticed in the wedding notices in The New York Times. Couples were cheerfully telling—as part of their "meet cute" stories—how their relationships began with one of them cheating on a spouse or long-time partner.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: From England, Ruby Wright has a story of an affair where—even years after it ended—it wasn't much discussed.
acts.title: Let Me Kiss Your Stiff Upper Lip

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Ira reviews some infidelity stats from his mother's book on the subject, Not Just Friends. And author James Braly tells a story of temptation live onstage at The Moth.
acts.title: The Italian Job

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Dani Shapiro on the confusing mess things can be during an affair. The story is from her memoir, Slow Motion.
acts.title: How Did I Get Here?

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: Etgar Keret describes the moment in the immediate aftermath of an affair. Actor Matt Malloy reads.
acts.title: The Man Who Knew What I Was About To Say
